images.filename: Secretary Kerry Signs the Guestbook After Presenting U.S. Medals to Members of New Zealand's Armed Forces in Wellington (22769809788).jpg
images.caption: U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry signs the guestbook after presenting U.S. medals to members of New Zealand’s armed forces who served alongside American troops during a visit to the Hall of Memories at the Pukeahu National War Memorial Park at Anzac Square in Wellington, New Zealand, on November 13, 2016. [State Department Photo/ Public Domain]
images.alt: U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry signs the guestbook after presenting U.S. medals to members of New Zealand’s armed forces who served alongside American troops during a visit to the Hall of Memories at the Pukeahu National War Memorial Park at Anzac Square in Wellington, New Zealand, on November 13, 2016. [State Department Photo/ Public Domain]
